name: vibemusic
description: vibeMusic 全栈音乐项目 - 工作区根配置

scripts.dev: concurrently -n musicapi,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:full: concurrently -n backend,api,web -c yellow,cyan,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.deploy:web: npm run build && npm run nginx:reload
scripts.docker:dev: docker compose up -d mysql redis minio
scripts.docker:restart: docker compose down && docker compose up -d --build
scripts.docker:monitor: docker compose up -d prometheus grafana alertmanager
scripts.docker:middleware: docker compose up -d mysql redis redis-exporter minio mysql-exporter nginx prometheus grafana alertmanager mysql-backup
scripts.docker:mid: docker compose up -d mysql redis redis-exporter minio prometheus grafana alertmanager mysql-backup
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run docker:up
scripts.install:all: cd musicapi && npm install && cd ../vibemusic-web && npm install
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
